auth_screens.style: Stark white background. Massive typography for the title. Input fields are flat with a 1px border (#E5E7EB), no shadow, and slightly rounded (rounded-xl). The primary button is full-width, Deep Charcoal (#111827), rounded-full, with crisp white text. 'Continue with Google' button should be white with a 1px border and the Google logo.

dashboard_hero_card.style: The centerpiece of the app. Background is Deep Charcoal (#111827) to anchor the view. Text is pure white. Inside: 'TOTAL MONTHLY' as a small, widely-tracked uppercase label (text-xs tracking-[0.15em] text-gray-400), followed by the massive total amount in Accent Finance color (#10B981) using text-5xl tracking-tighter. Includes a clean toggle to switch to 'Annual'. Render the soft abstract premium texture as an absolute positioned, low opacity (10%) image behind the text to give it a minted, premium feel.

subscription_list.style: Cardless layout to maintain minimalism. The list sits on the main background. Each item is separated by a subtle border-b (#E5E7EB). Left side: Icon container (h-12 w-12, rounded-xl, bg-gray-100, centered icon). Middle: Name (text-lg font-bold text-gray-900) and Category (text-sm text-gray-500). Right side: Price (text-lg font-bold text-gray-900) and Billing Cycle (text-xs text-gray-400).

floating_action_button.style: Positioned absolute at bottom-right (bottom-8 right-6). Large (h-16 w-16), rounded-full, Primary color (#111827) background, crisp white Lucide 'Plus' icon. Drops a sharp shadow-lg.

header_and_navigation.style: Minimalist header. The 'All My Costs' custom coin logo aligned to the left. An 'Export PDF' icon button aligned to the right. No bulky colored header bars; keep the background matching the screen.

category_selector.style: Horizontal scrollable list of pills. Active state: bg-gray-900 text-white. Inactive state: bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-600. Pill shape: rounded-full px-4 py-2.

logo_instructions.concept: A professional stylized coin with a question mark.
logo_instructions.implementation: Create a React Native component. Outer View: h-10 w-10, rounded-full, border-2 border-gray-900 bg-gray-50, flex items-center justify-center. Inner View: h-8 w-8, rounded-full, border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center. Text inside: '?' using a bold serif or Outfit font, text-xl text-gray-900.

icons.usage: Use strokeWidth={2}. Suggested mapping: Video (PlaySquare), Music (Music), Banking (Landmark), Services (Briefcase), Software (Monitor), Gaming (Gamepad2), Fitness (Dumbbell), Cloud (Cloud), Export (FileDown).

premium_texture.description: Soft abstract green texture to be used as a very low opacity background layer (e.g. 5-10% opacity) inside the main Dark Hero 'Total Cost' card to give it a premium, physical-asset feel without overwhelming the minimalist aesthetic.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, text inputs, list items, toggles) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based. Examples: 'login-submit-button', 'add-subscription-button', 'total-cost-display', 'export-pdf-button', 'subscription-item-Netflix'.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast_requirements: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast. White text on the #111827 card and #111827 text on the #F9FAFB background easily passes this.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React Native mobile app using Expo. All UI code must be inside standard React Native .js files (e.g., App.js, screens/Dashboard.js).
Apply styling via Tailwind CSS classes (NativeWind) if configured, or translate the provided Tailwind classes into React Native StyleSheet objects.
Use Async Storage for local-only device storage to save subscriptions, categories, and user preferences.
The UI must look identical on iOS and Android. Handle safe areas correctly using SafeAreaView.
Do not use generic fonts like Inter for headings. Use Outfit for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body if possible, or fallback to system sans-serif with strong font weights.
Implement the custom 'Coin Logo' using standard React Native Views as described in logo_instructions.
For the Add/Edit form, include a seamless currency selector and an option to create a 'Custom' category if the user doesn't find a predefined one.
Always provide a data-testid to TouchableOpacity, TextInput, and buttons.
